author: krealdesign
text:
Fiddled with Figma motion a bit.
Not bad at all, has its quirks but it’s still beta.

- Has keyframes, which is impossible to do any proper motion without. I couldn’t use Jitter for that reason. At first I almost quit but then found them - big props.

- Working with the timeline is quite janky right now. When selecting multiple items and want to move them or adjust duration, it selects the one you click on 8/10 times. The other 2 it works the group. Weird.

- Maybe I didn’t look long enough but no shortcuts for keyframes and selectinf specific values (scale/opacity/position etc). To work fast we need these. Since motion is heavily based on operating hundreds of keyframes many shortcuts are REQUIRED.

- More easing options than in Jitter. Custom one is cool - would love to have an option to replace standard ones with custom ones, not through variables. But I’ll try that and maybe that’s even better that way.

- Would love to see snapping to ms brackets

- Only tried export in mp4 - works good but colors get seriously fucked. Unacceptable for brand work. Maybe I did something wrong, but haven’t seen any advanced settings.

It’s too early but current verdict it’s great for more lively prototypes and small UI fun. Also for quick animated posts with your work for X. For even slightly more complex things or brand world showcase you will still have much easier and faster time in AE knowing the basics.

Can’t wait to see how/where it evolves and will be playong around with it.

author: keepyourpixel
text:
some alpha I took out from Config 2026.

main take: the line between design and development is officially gone.

the biggest highlights:

 - Code Layers - turns designs into real code, prompt to build, and even import GitHub repos to push PRs directly from the canvas.

- Figma Motion - native timeline animation is finally here. Export as MP4 or copy the code straight to dev mode.

- Generative Plugins - create your own custom plugins that actually travel with shared files.

- Shaders & Figma Agent - living backgrounds and AI that can generate designs right on the canvas.

Super Exiting!

text:
𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗙𝘂𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻 𝗝𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝗕𝗲𝗰𝗮𝗺𝗲 𝗠𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴. 💻✅

Figma just dropped some major updates at Config, and they go beyond adding new features. 

Here are the ones that caught my attention:

1) Code Layers: Run live code directly on the design canvas.
2) Figma Weave: More consistent product rendering.
3) Generative Plugins: Build plugins with AI, no coding required.
4) Shaders: Create richer visuals with 3D mesh gradients and lens effects.
5) Figma Motion: Native keyframe animations for more realistic prototypes.

My biggest takeaway?

As Figma becomes more powerful, the expectations of designers will naturally increase.

Creating beautiful static screens won't be enough anymore. Designers will increasingly be expected to think about motion, interactions, systems, and experiences that feel closer to the final product.

The tools are evolving, and so is the role of a product designer.

Exciting... but the bar just got a little higher. 

What’s your thought about this? Drop them in the comments section 💬👇

author: iskros
text:
На днях прошла конференция Config 2026, где Figma показала новые функции. Что интересного и как это повлияет на нашу работу ↓

• Code Layers – любой дизайн можно превратить в код, проверить, как работает и показать разработчику
• Figma Motion – полноценный инструмент для создания анимаций 
• Shaders – генерация эффектов с помощью промпта
• Generative Plugins – ИИ-агенты пишут плагины под твои задачи
• Weave Tools – ИИ-редактор изображений
• Figma Agent – теперь ИИ-агенты могут учитывать ТЗ проекта, твой подход к работе и искать лучшие практики в сети

Пару мыслей:
• дизайн теперь не просто макеты, но и код, что логично, иначе бы Figma проиграла конкуренцию ИИ-инструментам
• ИИ-агенты – это по сути коллеги, которые выполняют часть работы за тебя
• графика и анимация – удар в сторону Adobe и др, чтобы дизайнеры всю работу делали в Figma

Figma развивается логично. Работа дизайнера становится проще и появляется возможность сфокусироваться на интересном и более важном.

GPT-5.6シリーズのプレビューが公開。Sol / Terra / Lunaの3モデル構成で、TerraはGPT-5.5と同等性能で2倍安価とのこと。複数サブエージェントを使う「ultraモード」も導入。Codexを長時間タスクに活用するための実践ノウハウ「Codex-maxxing」も必読です📄

Geminiアプリに「スタディノートブック」機能が登場。知識のギャップ分析や個別最適化レッスンで学習を支援。Gemini 3.5 Flashにはコンピューター操作機能も追加されました。Google SheetsではGeminiが数式エラーの修正を支援するように。

text:
This exported with Figma Motion beta version 
12fps 960px x 960px

Here is a good TIP what I’ll do next.
- Create Large size of frame scene to animate 
- Export in 12fps
- Insert in any video editor and make it 60fps output
- & you are done 👍 

Thax
